page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 94489 GB of local HDD storage. This dense storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. The reliance on HDD technology instead of SSDs represents a tradeoff, prioritizing high-capacity raw storage volume over low-latency random I/O performance.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.d1ne.8xlarge offers a high density of local storage relative to its compute and memory resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring massive data retention without the premium cost of solid-state drives. Appropriate workloads for this profile include large-scale data warehousing, cold data archiving, distributed file systems, and batch processing tasks that can tolerate HDD latency.
